description: This file defines an abstract class 'TableValuedFunction' in the Spark SQL module, providing method signatures for table-valued functions such as range, explode, inline, json_tuple, and variant_explode, among others.

classes.name: TableValuedFunction
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface for invoking table-valued functions in Spark SQL.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Creates a Dataset of LongType elements in a specified range with optional start, end, step, and partition parameters.

methods.name: explode
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame with a row for each element in an array or map column.

methods.name: explode_outer
methods.description: Similar to explode but produces null for empty or null collections.

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame from an array of structs, expanding each struct into a row.

methods.name: inline_outer
methods.description: Like inline but produces null for null or empty arrays.

methods.name: json_tuple
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame from a JSON column based on specified fields.

methods.name: posexplode
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame with position and element for each item in an array or map.

methods.name: posexplode_outer
methods.description: Like posexplode but produces nulls for null or empty collections.

methods.name: stack
methods.description: Separates multiple columns into multiple rows.

methods.name: collations
methods.description: Retrieves all Spark SQL string collations.

methods.name: variant_explode
methods.description: Explodes a variant object/array into multiple rows with schema including position, key, and value.

methods.name: variant_explode_outer
methods.description: Like variant_explode but produces null for non-variant inputs.
